title: OMP 18.4.0 on Windows ends one-shot commands with their real status; 18.3.5's false drained-event-loop diagnostic is gone
question: Does unmodified OMP 18.4.0 on Windows x64 still print 18.3.5's false 'ended before completing' diagnostic after a finished `omp -p` turn, and still exit 1 after a complete `omp models` listing (can1357/oh-my-pi#13470)?
answer: No. With the documented RTX 4090 provider fragment, 18.3.5 exited 1 after a complete `omp models` listing in 5 of 5 runs and printed the false line after 5 of 5 finished `omp -p` turns that exited 0. 18.4.0 exited 0 with an empty stderr for 5 of 5 `omp models` listings and printed no false line in 5 of 5 `omp -p` turns; both versions print the existing 'Working...' indicator on stderr in text mode.

clients.18.3.5: omp-windows-x64.exe from https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/releases/tag/v18.3.5, SHA-256 verified against the release asset digest before running
clients.18.4.0: omp-windows-x64.exe from https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/releases/tag/v18.4.0, SHA-256 verified against the release asset digest before running

method.host: Windows 11 x64, the RTX 4090 native lane host; the lane stayed stopped and no GPU work ran
method.route: examples/windows-native/models.fragment.yml verbatim except baseUrl, which pointed at a local mock OpenAI Responses endpoint on 127.0.0.1:18199 that streams one complete response per request; each version ran in its own isolated HOME, USERPROFILE, LOCALAPPDATA, APPDATA and TEMP with NINFER_NATIVE_API_KEY set
method.drive: `omp --version`, then five alternating pairs of `omp models ninfer-native-4090 --json` and `omp -p --no-session --model ninfer-native-4090/qwen3.8-27b "Reply with OK."`, each launched with separate stdout and stderr redirection so the exit status and every stderr line were recorded
method.upstream_fix: can1357/oh-my-pi commit 9d3e0d4975 (fix(cli): kept exit code when loop resumed after beforeExit), in v18.4.0 (commit 401778d0cd30020ce0f9198f751b13c68850562f): the unsettled-command verdict moves from Bun's beforeExit, which Windows emits while I/O is still in flight, to exit

limits: Windows x64 only: upstream's fix names Windows, where Bun emits beforeExit while I/O is still in flight; the macOS arm64 and Linux x64 binaries were not probed here.
A mock endpoint served the turns, so this proves the client's completion status, not lane inference; documented-route acceptance covers the live lanes.
Five runs per command per version on one host.
